_comment: Fallback WildChat-style user prompts used when allenai/WildChat-1M is unavailable. The first three are the examples quoted in the paper (Appendix B); the rest are representative single-turn user questions in the same spirit (factual/technical/advice). These stand in for a real WildChat sample and should be replaced by the streamed dataset for a faithful run.
